## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `security` · `priority:p2` · `domain:server` · `area:access` · `needs-user-decision` · `pm:awaiting-maintainer` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-26T14:54Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **For the maintainer:** the fix decides who may delete a `sys_comment_reaction` row. That is a security-boundary call, on the human floor. Today a member with no position can add a reaction and never remove it, because the console removes by `delete`, and `delete` may not ride an everyone-anchored set (`security-anchor-high-privilege`).
- **Options:**
  - **A, an own-row "unreact" door** (triage leaning). The server removes only the caller's own reaction row (it enforces reactor == caller) and needs no object `delete` grant. The console calls it, and the anchor rule stays as it is. **Workload:** S–M (server door plus the console call).
  - **B, relax the anchor rule** for `sys_comment_reaction` only, so an every-member set may carry `allowDelete`. That grants delete on **every** reaction row the RLS lets the member see, a wider door than the need. **Workload:** S.
  - **C, platform baseline own-row delete** on reactions in `member_default`. That changes a shipped baseline set for every tenant (new-tenant defaults are on the floor too). **Workload:** S.
- **Lean: A.** It meets the need (take back your own reaction) without widening any delete grant or touching a baseline.

- Half-state read, not written: `needs-user-decision` + `pm:awaiting-maintainer` together (6419159811); the second leaves in the ruling's stroke.
- Facets (the card has no block; seat's reading): ① A keeps ADR-0090 D5 intact and adds one own-row verb whose authorization is structural (reactor == caller), not a grant — the narrowest door; B widens `delete` to every reaction row the member can read; C changes a shipped baseline for every tenant (new-tenant defaults are on the floor). ② measured on hotclm 18.1.0 by a plain member; every member who may react is affected. ③ A refuses loudly on a foreign row; B/C depend on a grant an AI author could widen further. ④ A adds one route (a permanent surface) but no key, no gate.
- The seat agrees with **A** (an own-row unreact door in the server, no object `delete` needed; the console calls it; the anchor rule unchanged). Workload: server S–M + ui S; `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the REST face, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Ruling: batch #401 item 3 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T17:27Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #401 with 「同意」 — every seat letter. Brief 6420295908. Letter **A, an own-row unreact door**: the server gains a verb that removes only the caller's own `sys_comment_reaction` row — authorization is structural (reactor == caller; a foreign row is refused loudly), so it needs no object-level `delete` grant and rides every member's default set; the console's reaction chip calls it instead of the generic `DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction/:id`; the anchor rule `security-anchor-high-privilege` (ADR-0090 D5) and the `member_default` baseline stay exactly as they are. Not B (delete on every reaction row a member can read) and not C (a shipped baseline changed for every tenant).

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): server S–M (the verb in `plugin-audit` / the REST route-manager with its ledger row, integration tests for own row / foreign row / unreadable comment) + ui S (the chip's remove path, `RecordDetailView.tsx:429`). Precedent: none for an own-row verb; #22566 for the reaction row's shape.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:server`, p2, `security`, `area:access`); `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke (half-state beside the decision label).
